narratives.Description: docs(design-critique): Grok critic spawn from primary fails two ways; dest-rooted grok CLI is the working seat
narratives.Overview: Spec is Bound remedy lean 5636098179, not the filed leftover-always-deny / try-native-then-CLI body. Native admit without skip-class is implement-class, not a critic. Deny string must name dest-rooted grok --cwd --prompt-file. Skill stays a pointer. Full thread: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4391

items.title: Do not bind leftover-on-primary as a universal native deny. Count selects the class: 2+ Deny 1; 0 is #2885; 1 eligible + dest cwd + parent id is spawn-ready implement-class (dest-lock, leftover file_scope). Documenting the 2-deny retry loop does not close the 1-eligible admit.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher-spawn-dest.test.ts#does not lead Grok multiple-eligible spawn-not-ready with scope:activate

items.title: Native admit without skip-class (spawn-process-only-ready) is not a critic seat. Either CLI after any native outcome that is not that skip-class, or wait on #4315 so native can express process_only. Keep retarget default Grok seat to CLI forbidden. Keep dual-launch forbidden.

Grok spawn-not-ready copy: name dest-rooted grok --cwd --prompt-file after recorded native deny as the critic recovery. Do not lead with scope:activate or DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE for this class. Playbook keeps argv. Skill stays a pointer (pack source, 80-line cap).
Say dest-rooted CLI is envelope-only process-only until #4219. Do not skip #4066 dest-proven. Dest still required.
Name the third Grok dest deny: isolation=worktree plus cwd is invalid-extra-destination, not dest-missing.
